Definition: Jeuel, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jeuel was of the sons of Zerah, counted among the families of Judah that returned to Jerusalem. He stands with his brethren, six hundred and ninety, in the record of those who came back.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts the returnees by name and by number, and Jeuel's six hundred and ninety are His.
